purpose: Visual canon for Content Studio agents: YouTube channel look + image-generation references. Do not invent a second palette.
how_agents_use: Read this file before writing image_prompt, thumbnails, or channel art.
Open the listed PNG/JPG as the look-and-feel reference for that channel.
Prefix every generated image_prompt with the channel image_prompt_prefix.
Never mix surfaces: @opsly = ICSO eye/hexagon; Universe boards = story worlds only.
Never use Peskids logos, firebase, or client_secret files as brand art.
studio_note: YouTube Data API cannot set the profile picture. Human uploads avatar + banner in Studio. About text is config/content-studio/channels/opsly/channel-about.txt.

opsly.image_prompt_prefix: Match ICSO Opsly brand: stylized cyan eye inside a thin hexagon with green vertex dots, dark navy #0A0E27 background, cyan #00FFFF and green #22C55E accents, illustrated control-plane / terminal diagrams, Spanish subtitle, no real faces, no secrets, no kids cartoon characters, no Peskids

opsly-universe.image_prompt_prefix: Match Opsly Universe boards: cinematic illustrated science-fantasy, navy/cyan/gold/violet, Traveler + Nova + Kai/Echo consistent character sheets from guardianes-del-conocimiento, turquoise portals, floating islands, no real child faces, no ICSO eye as the hero mark, no Peskids

style_tokens: Bitsitos island = tech and coding city
bitsitos.image_prompt_prefix: Match Bitsitos pocket of Opsly Universe (tech/coding island on the-map-unfolds): friendly cartoon kids-tech, turquoise and amber, no scary AI, no Peskids logo, no ICSO eye as mascot

splashitos.image_prompt_prefix: Match Splashitos pocket of Opsly Universe (ocean/life island on the-map-unfolds): water teal, safe swim/sports cartoon, adult supervision implied, no Peskids logo

clicksitos.image_prompt_prefix: Match Clicksitos gaming: dark HUD, violet #7C3AED to magenta, aim/crosshair motifs, 13+ not kids, no ICSO eye, no Universe child explorers, no Peskids
